contexts.text: And summer and winter () = the state of the regenerate man as to his new voluntary things, the alternations of which are circumstanced as are summer and winter. Explained.

As there is nothing but evil in the regenerate man, he cannot but undergo alternations, and now be as it were in summer and now in winter - that is, in no charity. There are such alternations in order that the man may be perfected more and more... (It is the same) in the other life; for without alternations as of summer and winter as to voluntary things, and as of day and night as to intellectual ones, he cannot be perfected, and rendered more happy; but these alternations in the other life are as those of summer and winter in the temperate zones... Illustrated.
This comes to pass in the time of spring and summer. Described... If man is like spring, or summer...
These are the states to which correspond the seasons of spring and summer upon earth.
(In the Sixth Earth) they have perpetual spring and summer... because the year is so short...
Summer and noon are turned (with the Angels) into the idea of love and wisdom such as they are in their second state.
(By summer is meant the fulness of the Church.)
When the heat and light do not make a one in the Heavens, there is either as it were summer, or winter... such as that in the tropics.
By house of winter, and house of summer () are signified those things of the natural man which are called sensuous.
